question_text: I have hands but I cannot clap. What am I?
I fall down but I never get hurt. What am I?
The more you take away from me the bigger I get. What am I?
I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?
I follow you all day long but disappear at night. What am I?
I have many teeth but I cannot bite. What am I?
I am yellow and curved and monkeys love me. What am I?
I have keys but open no locks. What am I?
I am full of holes but I still hold water. What am I?
What goes up but never comes down?
accepted_answers: age | how old you are | my age
